Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office notices issued from 28 January 2026 about additions, revocations/delistings and variations/corrections to the UK Sanctions List .
See previous financial sanctions notices for Russia issued by the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation prior to 28 January 2026.
This regime provides for the designation of individuals and entities who are or have been involved in:
destabilising Ukraine or undermining or threatening the territorial integrity, sovereignty or independence of Ukraine, or
obtaining a benefit from or supporting the Government of Russia
Ships may be specified as set out in [regulation 57F](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/855/regulation/57F].

There are also sectoral financial sanctions which prohibit and restrict specified activities. These include restrictions on dealing with transferable securities or money-market instruments and granting or entering into arrangements to grant loans or credit.
See: Entities subject to financial and investment restrictions under the Russia sanctions.
Each notice sets out for the relevant date the:
delistings – removals from the list following a decision by the UN
revocations – removals from the list following an official decision-making process
variations – changes to a designation following an official decision-making process
For additions the notice lists the new entry.
For delistings and revocations the notice lists the entries that are being removed.
